name: swipe-tabs
title: Swipe Tabs
description: Swipe horizontally to move between panels and update the active tab.
useCases: On a mobile product page, a shopper swipes between the description, specifications and reviews.
In a course workspace, a student opens a link to the practice tab. The app sets the active ID and updates the URL on subsequent changes.
task: Swipe horizontally to move between panels and update the active tab.

models.SwipeTab: type SwipeTab = { id: string; title: string; content: ReactNode };

behavior: Each item has a stable id, title and content. Use defaultValue to seed the tab or value and onChange for external control.
